spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:**

In what way shall the fundamental qualities of the human spirit be elevated , each into the degree above it ?

**¶2:**

Wisdom in its lowest natural form shall be gathered into love , for all understanding exists for the sake of the aff ection that receives it. And love itself shall be gathered into truth, for the will pur ifies itself only through the tru ths that give it form. And truth shall be gathered into the rational spirit , for natural tru ths serve only to open the interior breathing of spiritual thought . And the rational spirit shall be gathered into the sphere of interior perception , for thought that reasons from tru ths must yield to the atmosphere of direct app rehension. And direct apprehension shall be gathered into the acknowledg ment that answers the Divine — that is, the interior reception that rises in the soul when it perce ives the Lord 's influx. And that reception shall be gathered into the Divine calling itself, for every response the soul makes exists within the prior summ oning of the Lord. And the calling shall be gathered into the pur ified understanding , which is the interior rational wholly cleansed of falsity . And the purified understanding shall be gathered into Divine Truth in its full conn ective power — the living order through which all things of the mind asc end toward their origin . And this living order shall be gathered into the Divine Human , and the Divine Human into the Lord as He proceeds forth toward what is His own, and that proce eding into the Infinite Divine itself.

**¶3:** They are elevated in this manner ; yet this asc ent is accomplished once and finally — not repeated as in the oscill ations of tem ptation, but completed — and all these qualities of the spirit rise together into the eternal peace of the heavenly state, which is rest in the Lord without end.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: In what way shall the elements be gathered in, from one to another?

The light shall be gathered in to the fire, and the fire itself gathered in to the water, and the water gathered in to the wind, and the wind gathered to the air, and the air gathered to the Answer, and the Answer gathered to the Summons. Also, the Summons to the purified Mind, which is the Intellectual. The Intellectual to the Pillar of Glory, [the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the First Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to] the aeons of greatness.
They are gathered in like this; but, they will be gathered on one occasion only, and go up above to the place of rest for ever and ever.
